Fold the blanket into the target shape on the table, then release it and withdraw. The blanket (600 mm x 480 mm) starts lying flat on the table. Fold it in half: turn the far half (the 240 mm of material along the far long edge) over onto the near half about the middle line parallel to the long edges, so that the far edge lies on the near edge and the far corners on the near corners. The folded stack is 600 mm x 240 mm, two layers, the far half upside down on top. The target images show the required final state: this is how the folded cloth must look and where it must lie; fold it like this. Near, far, left and right are as seen in the overhead camera cam_high (near = the lower side of its image).

Fold the blanket into the target shape on the table, then release it and withdraw. The blanket (600 mm x 480 mm) starts lying flat on the table. Then dog-ear the top layer: turn the top layer's near-left corner (the blanket's original far-left corner) over onto the top layer, the top layer alone, so that its corner point (12 mm in from both edges) lands 100 mm to the right and 100 mm farther than where it lay after the half fold; the crease runs at about 45 degrees across the corner. Build the EKET cabinet frame: slide the two side panels into the top panel, then the back panel into its grooves, then the bottom panel onto the sides, and leave the cabinet standing on the table on its own.
Build the GLADOM tray table: cross frame B into frame A, drive the long screw and the bottom screw, place the ring and drive its two screws, and set the tray on the ring.

Rebuild the IKEA 365+ serving stand: take the screw out of member A and park it, lay member B across member A, bring the screw back and screw it in through both members until it seats, turn the stand over, and place the bowl on it.
Screw all four legs onto the four threaded studs of the tabletop.

Build the STEGESUND roll stand: press half B onto half A at the two leg crossings, push the shelf in from the foot end, drive the four bolts through the legs into the shelf's rail ends with the hex key, stand the frame up and drop the top rod into the two crotches.
Press the lamp shade's key down into the socket on top of the stand column until the spring jaw snaps over it, then screw the E12 bulb up into the shade's socket until it seats.
Assemble the VARIERA shelf insert: place the two side frames, lower the shelf onto them, and drive the four screws through the shelf holes into the frames' receivers until they seat.

Build the VESKEN shelf unit body: snap the four feet into the bottom tray from below, the four columns into the bottom tray, the second tray onto the columns, four columns and a tray for each of the two upper levels, and the four caps into the top tray.
